echo '
handoff_resolve_root() {
  handoff_root=$(pwd -P) || return 1
  handoff_global=${AGNOSTIC_AI_HOME:-${HOME-}/.agnostic-ai}
  handoff_global=$(cd "$handoff_global" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || handoff_global=
  handoff_cursor=$handoff_root

    if [ "$handoff_cursor" != "$handoff_global" ] &&
       { [ -f "$handoff_cursor/agnostic-ai.yaml" ] ||
         [ -f "$handoff_cursor/agnostic.config.yaml" ]; }; then
      handoff_root=$handoff_cursor
      return 0
    fi
    handoff_parent=$(dirname "$handoff_cursor") || return 1
    [ "$handoff_parent" = "$handoff_cursor" ] && break
    handoff_cursor=$handoff_parent
  done
  handoff_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
}
handoff_cleanup() {
  if [ -n "${handoff_temp-}" ]; then
    rm -f "$handoff_temp" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
}
handoff_reply() {
  if [ "$handoff_tool" != factory ]; then
    printf "%s
" "{}"
  fi
}
handoff_stop() {
  handoff_cleanup
  handoff_reply
  exit 0
}
handoff_branch_slug() {
  LC_ALL=C awk -v branch="$handoff_branch" -f - <<"HANDOFF_SLUG"
BEGIN {
  for (n = 128; n < 256; n++) byte[sprintf("%c", n)] = n
  for (i = 1; i <= length(branch); i++) {
    c = substr(branch, i, 1)
    if (c ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]$/) printf "%s", c
    else {
      printf "-"
      n = byte[c]
      if (n >= 192 && n < 224) i++
      else if (n >= 224 && n < 240) i += 2
      else if (n >= 240 && n < 248) i += 3
    }
  }
}
HANDOFF_SLUG
}

    [ -f "$handoff_path" ] || return 1
    [ "$(sed -n "1{p;q;}" "$handoff_path")" = "# Automatic handoff" ] || return 1
    handoff_header=$(sed -n "2{p;q;}" "$handoff_path") || return 1
    case "$handoff_header" in *" | branch: $handoff_branch | head: "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac

  handoff_detached=" | detached: false"
  [ "$handoff_branch_status" -ne 1 ] || handoff_detached=" | detached: true"

worktree: %s%s

## Git status

## Last five commits

%s

    handoff_temp=

  fi

handoff_snapshot() {

  cd "$handoff_root" || return 1

    0) ;;
    1) handoff_branch=detached ;;
    *) return 1 ;;

  handoff_status=$(git status --short) || return 1
  handoff_commits=$(git -c log.showSignature=false --no-pager log -5 --format=%s) || return 1
  case "$handoff_tool" in
    claude|codex|gemini|qoder|factory) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;

  handoff_checkout=${handoff_checkout%?}
  handoff_worktree=$handoff_checkout

  handoff_checkout=${handoff_checkout%?}

  [ "$handoff_branch_status" -ne 1 ] || handoff_slug=detached-$handoff_head

      handoff_suffix=${handoff_root#"$handoff_checkout"}
      if handoff_write_snapshot "$handoff_main$handoff_suffix/.agnostic-ai/local/handoffs/$handoff_slug.auto.md" task "$handoff_main"; then
        handoff_shared_done=true
      fi
    fi
  fi
  handoff_dir=$handoff_root/.agnostic-ai/local
  if [ "$handoff_shared_done" != true ]; then
    handoff_write_snapshot "$handoff_dir/handoffs/$handoff_slug.auto.md" task "$handoff_checkout"
  fi
  handoff_write_snapshot "$handoff_dir/HANDOFF.auto.md" legacy "$handoff_checkout"
}

      handoff_root=$handoff_cursor
      return 0
    fi

    handoff_cursor=$handoff_parent
  done
  handoff_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
}
handoff_entry_key() {
  case "$handoff_header" in *" | branch: "*" | head: "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  handoff_record_branch=${handoff_header#*" | branch: "}
  handoff_record_branch=${handoff_record_branch%%" | head: "*}
  handoff_record_head=${handoff_header#*" | head: "}
  handoff_record_head=${handoff_record_head%%" | "*}
  handoff_key=branch:$handoff_record_branch
  handoff_extra=$(sed -n "3{p;q;}" "$handoff_file") || return 1
  case "$handoff_extra" in
    *" | detached: true") handoff_key=detached:$handoff_record_head; return 0 ;;
    *" | detached: false") return 0 ;;
  esac
  if [ "$handoff_record_branch" = detached ] &&
     [ "${handoff_file##*/}" = "detached-$handoff_record_head.auto.md" ]; then
    handoff_key=detached:$handoff_record_head
  fi
}
handoff_task_notice() {
  handoff_checkout=$(CDPATH= cd "$handoff_root" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
  handoff_checkout=$(cd "$handoff_checkout" && pwd -P) || return 1
  handoff_branch=$(CDPATH= cd "$handoff_root" && git branch --show-current) || return 1
  handoff_current_key=branch:$handoff_branch
  handoff_current_label=$handoff_branch
  if [ -z "$handoff_branch" ]; then
    handoff_current_head=$(CDPATH= cd "$handoff_root" && git rev-parse HEAD) || return 1
    handoff_current_key=detached:$handoff_current_head
    handoff_current_label=detached-$handoff_current_head
  fi

  handoff_shared=

    handoff_main=$(cd "$handoff_main" && pwd -P) || return 1
    handoff_suffix=${handoff_root#"$handoff_checkout"}
    handoff_candidate=$handoff_main$handoff_suffix/.agnostic-ai/local/handoffs
    if [ -d "$handoff_candidate" ]; then
      if handoff_candidate=$(cd "$handoff_candidate" && pwd -P) &&
         case "$handoff_candidate" in
           "${handoff_main%/}/"*) handoff_shared_relative=${handoff_candidate#"${handoff_main%/}/"} ;;
           *) false ;;
         esac &&
         (CDPATH= cd "$handoff_main" && git check-ignore -q -- "$handoff_shared_relative/handoff.md"); then
        handoff_shared=$handoff_candidate
      fi
    fi
  fi
  handoff_local=$handoff_dir/handoffs
  if [ "$handoff_checkout" = "$handoff_main" ] && [ -n "$handoff_shared" ]; then
    handoff_count=0
    handoff_seen=" "
    for handoff_file in "$handoff_shared"/*.md; do
      [ -f "$handoff_file" ] && [ ! -L "$handoff_file" ] || continue
      (CDPATH= cd "$handoff_main" && git check-ignore -q -- "$handoff_shared_relative/${handoff_file##*/}") || continue
      handoff_header=$(sed -n "2{p;q;}" "$handoff_file") || continue
      handoff_entry_key || continue
      case "$handoff_seen" in *" $handoff_key "*) continue ;; esac
      handoff_seen="$handoff_seen$handoff_key "
      handoff_count=$((handoff_count + 1))
    done
    if [ "$handoff_count" -gt 0 ]; then
      handoff_plural=s
      if [ "$handoff_count" -eq 1 ]; then handoff_plural=; fi
      handoff_message="$handoff_count task handoff$handoff_plural available. Ask to resume a task handoff."
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  for handoff_kind in manual auto; do
    for handoff_store in "$handoff_shared" "$handoff_local"; do
      [ -n "$handoff_store" ] || continue
      handoff_ignore_root=$handoff_store
      handoff_ignore_prefix=
      if [ "$handoff_store" = "$handoff_shared" ]; then
        handoff_ignore_root=$handoff_main
        handoff_ignore_prefix=$handoff_shared_relative/
      fi
      for handoff_file in "$handoff_store"/*.md; do
        [ -f "$handoff_file" ] && [ ! -L "$handoff_file" ] || continue
        handoff_slug=${handoff_file##*/}
        handoff_slug=${handoff_slug%.md}
        case "$handoff_slug" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) continue ;; esac
        (CDPATH= cd "$handoff_ignore_root" && git check-ignore -q -- "$handoff_ignore_prefix${handoff_file##*/}") || continue
        handoff_title=$(sed -n "1{p;q;}" "$handoff_file") || continue
        case "$handoff_kind:$handoff_title" in manual:"# Handoff"|auto:"# Automatic handoff") ;; *) continue ;; esac
        handoff_header=$(sed -n "2{p;q;}" "$handoff_file") || continue
        handoff_entry_key || continue
        [ "$handoff_key" = "$handoff_current_key" ] || continue
        handoff_display=$handoff_current_label
        case "$handoff_display" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._/-]*) handoff_display=$handoff_slug ;; esac
        if [ "$handoff_kind" = auto ]; then
          handoff_message="Git snapshot available: .agnostic-ai/local/handoffs/$handoff_slug.md (branch $handoff_display). Ask to resume the handoff."
        else
          handoff_message="Task handoff available: .agnostic-ai/local/handoffs/$handoff_slug.md (branch $handoff_display). Ask to resume the handoff."
        fi
        return 0
      done
    done
  done
  return 1
}

      printf "%s

    if [ "$handoff_tool" = factory ]; then

" "Handoff available: .agnostic-ai/local/HANDOFF.md and HANDOFF.auto.md. Ask to resume the handoff."
    else
      cat <<EOF
{"systemMessage":"Handoff available: .agnostic-ai/local/HANDOFF.md and HANDOFF.auto.md. Ask to resume the handoff."}
EOF
    fi
  elif [ -f "$handoff_dir/HANDOFF.md" ]; then
    if [ "$handoff_tool" = factory ]; then
      printf "%s
" "Handoff available: .agnostic-ai/local/HANDOFF.md. Ask to resume the handoff."
    else
      cat <<EOF
{"systemMessage":"Handoff available: .agnostic-ai/local/HANDOFF.md. Ask to resume the handoff."}
EOF
    fi
  elif [ -f "$handoff_dir/HANDOFF.auto.md" ]; then
    if [ "$handoff_tool" = factory ]; then
      printf "%s
" "Git snapshot available: .agnostic-ai/local/HANDOFF.auto.md. Ask to resume the handoff."
    else
      cat <<EOF
{"systemMessage":"Git snapshot available: .agnostic-ai/local/HANDOFF.auto.md. Ask to resume the handoff."}
EOF
    fi
  else
    return 1
  fi
}

if ! handoff_notice </dev/null 2>/dev/null; then
  if [ "$handoff_tool" != factory ]; then
    printf "%s
" "{}"
  fi
